events.headline: Jacobs placed on Commissioner's Exempt list to open the season — can't practice or play; Packers trade for Steelers RB Kaleb Johnson as extra insurance alongside Lloyd
events.detail: Updates the Aug. 27 item. The NFL placed Jacobs on the commissioner's exempt list Sunday (Aug. 30) while its conduct-policy review continues — he cannot practice or play in any capacity for as long as he's on it, and GM Brian Gutekunst has said a suspension could still follow once the league's review concludes. events.so_what: This moves Jacobs from 'suspension risk' to a confirmed Week 1 zero, and likely a multi-week one — he cannot play until the exempt list is lifted, regardless of how the eventual conduct case resolves. Lloyd is still the presumptive first man up on current camp usage, but Johnson's arrival makes Green Bay's backfield a real hold-both situation on this format's 5-man bench for anyone rostering either piece; track practice reps once the 53-man dust settles to see who actually gets the start.
